name: 13925-imageprefill-internvl8b-tp4
model: OpenGVLab/InternVL2_5-8B. 16.2 GB of safetensors, public and ungated, ~4 GB per card at TP4.
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One node, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: InternVLChatModel: an InternViT-300M vision tower in front of an InternLM2 7B language model. Layer counts and dimensions are in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8. Warmup the first 30%, bounded at 600 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text` + `synthetic_image`, one turn, ONE image per request: a 1344x1792 gradient PNG and a 64-token text prompt in, 32 tokens out, all three lengths FIXED with `ignore_eos: true` and `temperature: 0.0`. The image dimensions are part of the declaration, not a placeholder -- another size or aspect ratio is a different request.
purpose: A visual question answering service for high-resolution images, serving eight concurrent users short replies across four GPUs.
launch:
# The engine's command line: sglang at commit f33e5d1ef150006278c5eba3329ff0d9d8fddaa6
# (`git describe --tags` = v0.5.5.post3-287-gf33e5d1ef15).

model-path: OpenGVLab/InternVL2_5-8B
tp-size: 4

# The checkpoint ships a custom modelling file and its own tokenizer.
trust-remote-code: true

# The template sglang's own registry maps InternVLChatModel to (`parser/conversation.py`).
chat-template: internvl-2-5

attention-backend: flashinfer
mem-fraction-static: 0.7
chunked-prefill-size: 8192
disable-radix-cache: true
mm-enable-dp-encoder: true
